title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Premium Accounting: Program Account, Statements and Suspension
content:
### 1. Posting
Every certificate premium and credit of a **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** program posts to that program's single account and appears on the statement for the calendar month in which it is posted. The statement cycle is monthly; the statement is dated the first day of the following month and is due 30 calendar days after its date (the tier's statement due period).

### 2. Application of payments
Lender payments are applied to the oldest open statement first.

### 3. Suspension of new placements
New placements are suspended only when the oldest unpaid statement is more than 60 calendar days (the tier's suspension threshold) past its due date, counted by adding the days to that due date on the calendar, the day itself not qualifying. The program's records show the due date of the oldest unpaid statement; that recorded date, not a statement by the lender, is the starting point. Suspension moves the program from active to suspended.

| Day reached, counted on the calendar from the due date of the oldest unpaid statement | Suspension of new placements |
|---|---|
| Any day up to and including the day that is 60 days after the due date | Not yet |
| The day after that | Applies |

*Boundary illustration (hypothetical):* for a hypothetical due date, the day reached by adding 60 days on the calendar does not itself qualify; the following day does.

### 4. While suspended
Certificates already issued stay in force and renew, credits keep posting, and claims are paid.

### 5. Reinstatement
On every tier placements resume once every past-due statement is paid; the program moves back from suspended to active.

### 6. Credit balance
A credit balance on the account is refunded to the lender on its request or at termination. **This sentence is no longer in force as written:** a refund paid on the lender's request while the program is active or suspended is figured under the program's credit refund rules, and only a credit balance on a terminated program is still refunded to the lender in full at termination.

superseded_clauses: A credit balance on the account is refunded to the lender on its request or at termination.
